flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code to receive a PayNow refund status. The Payment Gateway integration in ocmsadminprivateapi (UraPgServiceImpl) only sends AXS transactions outbound for payment reconciliation. The ocms_refund_notice table has no status column; there is no Cumulus interface.
note: Status Removed. Not claimed. The words paynow and cumulus do not appear in the six repos; there is no inbound endpoint for a refund status, no status column in ocms_refund_notice, and no sending to Cumulus. No relevant maintenance ticket. Payment Gateway, PayNow and Cumulus: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS receives the PayNow refund status from Payment Gateway (successful/unsuccessful)
steps.detail: There is no inbound endpoint, cron or parser for a PayNow refund status. The gateway integration is outbound only (UraPgServiceImpl.sendAxsTransactions, lines 113-150) and the response it reads is the reply to sending AXS transactions, not a refund status. The webhook in thirdpartyapi is for CES only (CesCreateNoticeController). A grep for paynow and refund in ocmseserviceapi and thirdpartyapi: 0 results.

steps.step: OCMS updates the refund advice details with the refund status
steps.detail: The ocms_refund_notice table has no refund status or PayNow result column (OcmsRefundNotice.java:26-58), and the controller has no update endpoint (only create and refundnoticelist, OcmsRefundNoticeController.java:43,76).

steps.step: The updated refund advice is interfaced to Cumulus
steps.detail: There is no Cumulus interface (grep cumulus: 0 results in the six repos). Same as OCMS46.6 step 1.

steps.step: Cumulus knows the refund was processed successfully via PayNow
steps.detail: The end result depends on the Cumulus and Payment Gateway sides, which are not in the repos (cannot verify from repo). On the OCMS side no code sends a PayNow status, so Cumulus cannot learn it from OCMS.
